jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.weight_rule: Use grams with clear gross and net weight labels when both matter.
jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.stone_rule: Do not call a stone diamond, precious, natural, certified or real without confirmation.
jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.investment_rule: Do not promise returns, appreciation, profit or capital protection.
jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.emi_rule: Display interest, tenure, fees and eligibility accurately.
jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.offer_rule: State branch, validity and all important conditions.
jewellery_accuracy_and_compliance.religious_or_astrology_rule: Birthstone and belief content must avoid guaranteed health, wealth, relationship or destiny outcomes.
